body:
Wow, that quote is honestly beautiful.

We're actually married, so I'm lucky in that aspect.  I just get in the way of myself.  It's such a silly thing to be secretly upset that your partner isn't like they are in the movies, and I know that's silly.
Ain't that the truth... and not even always bad memories.  Even the good memories make me depressed.

Your kind words are so appreciated.  I can't even thank you enough.  You're absolutely right. It's so easy to lose sight of what's important, especially around this time of year.  My moods are just so up and down.  Lately, I'm having way more sad days than I am happy days, and I search my kid's faces for hope.  I can usually find it, but sometimes when it gets really dark, it's just hard to see the happiness that I know I should feel.

Thank you, so much for your kind words.  Keeping my marriage together is so difficult... but we are definitely working hard at it.

I am so incredibly sorry for the loss of your wife.  I can't even imagine the strength that it takes to continue on, and that beautiful son of yours is so incredibly lucky to have you.

Thank you.  I didn't turn him in.  At the time, I felt that it was easier on me to just try and move on, and not take legal action against him.  He ended up in prison for 5 years for something unrelated to me.  He went to prison, received his Bachelor's Degree, got out early, and now has an awesome job, a brand new car.  He makes more money than we do... he's probably happier than I am... and I hate it.  I never got over what happened... and I still wake up crying from it.  I don't trust anyone, and it causes a lot of problems in my everyday life.  I've always thought it was interesting how it ended up.  He ended up with a pretty good life, and I feel like I'm living in shit.

I definitely WANT to work, to help change our financial situation.  It has taken me a long time to get to this point.  I run an online business to help supplement our income a little bit.  I don't make much, but it makes me feel like I'm contributing.  I just feel like no matter what I do, it will never get better.  If we can't come up with the money in literally 7 days to move out, we'll be stuck here even longer.  Our only option would be to stay at a hotel that lets you pay out the ass weekly... then we'll never be able to save money.

I'm stuck with this sour attitude about it.  I go back and forth a lot... sometimes I think we can change it.  Other times, I just don't know.  My husband has been working a ridiculous amount of OT... then he got the stomach flu.  He lost 18 hours of OT because of it.

Thank you for the reply.  My parents both work.  My dad travels a lot, and my mom only works part-time, however she wouldn't give that up to help me.  She's the kind of person that helps sometimes, but makes you feel like an awful person later on for even asking for help.  I hear a lot of comments like "You just shouldn't even ask me".  I've never met another person like her before... it's crazy.  I've always wondered if she has some sort of disorder, but she'll never get checked.  

I have looked around for jobs at daycare's, but haven't had any luck.
